config.notes: Pages: www.manukau.ac.nz/programme/<slug>/ (WordPress, text only, no page JSON). Panel headings: "Duration and study methods", "Start dates" (months printed, sometimes per year or per strand), "Qualification ... Programme code: NZ/MN####", "Credits", "Location", "Domestic fees", "International fees". Fee read only as the international amount printed "per 120 credits" (one full-time NZ year); "per 60/80/30 credits" amounts are whole-programme or module prices and are not read. "International fees: Not available to international students" is read as not_admitting. IELTS overall from the Entry requirements text (first IELTS figure). No term names, so no term_months. Central key dates: https://www.manukau.ac.nz (Key dates and timetables link) - not attached. Delivery (mode): the page prints no delivery label; the Location panel names the campus or says Online, so mode is read only when the Location text contains Online (campus-only pages give no mode reading). Identity: MIT page titles drop the leading "New Zealand" of the qualification name (e.g. "Certificate in Floristry (Level 3) | Manukau Institute of Technology"), so course_title_strip removes it from the catalogue title before the title check. 5 Oct: 36 courses rebound by hand to their own programme pages. 5 Oct 15:22 checks: no exit awards and no whole-course fees on stored pages (international fee is printed per 120 credits). entry_requirement reads the first sentence of the 'Entry requirements' section (one section for all students), shown for review only. 35 programme pages are bound by hand, so apply does not re-read them.
